about_the_game:
Welcome to The Neeblarium — a living terrarium of tiny, curious creatures called Neeblies. Watch them hatch, play, and form shimmering little societies that grow, change, and remember.

At first, you’re simply their caretaker — dropping eggs into fertile zones, offering toys for joy, and feeding rare superfoods to guide their lives. Each Neeblie carries a unique genetic code, passing traits and colors through generations. Families emerge. Lineages bloom. Golden Neeblies — mythic and radiant — appear only once in a great while, living for years if nurtured with care.

But that’s only the beginning.

As your colony thrives, you’ll unlock The Geneticist’s Toolkit — a cozy, diegetic lab where you can design life itself. Tune traits like size, speed, temperament, or social instinct; run miniature test-dish simulations to observe behavior; then synthesize custom eggs and introduce them into your living world. Watch your creations mingle with natural lineages and see how evolution plays out in real time.

Every player’s Neeblarium becomes a unique ecosystem — an ongoing experiment in color, curiosity, and care. Will your strains bring harmony… or chaos?

✨ Features

  • A Cozy, Living World — Hundreds of independent Neeblies, each with their own needs, moods, and family bonds.

  • Diegetic Tray Interface — A tactile, toy-box UI where every action (eggs, toys, superfoods) feels part of the world.

  • Emergent Genetics — True inheritance and mutation across generations; no two Neeblies are alike.

  • Golden Neeblies — Mythic rarities with eight-year lifespans and luminous heritage lines.

  • The Geneticist’s Toolkit (Post-Launch Update) — Craft genomes, test behaviors, and create your own lineages in a cozy laboratory setting.

  • Heritage & Pedigrees — Local-first lineage tracking; every birth, death, and mutation recorded.

  • Fully Diegetic Economy — Earn Charms by simply being present; spend them to nurture your colony or fuel experiments.

  • Optional Deep Dive — Observe, tinker, or just relax and watch your Neeblies go about their tiny lives.

🪴 A Game That Grows With You

The Neeblarium is designed as a long-term sandbox — equal parts life sim, genetics toy, and cozy diorama.
Start as an observer, become a caretaker, and ultimately evolve into a creator of worlds.
